name: Oblique Crunch
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent, feet planted flat, and fingertips placed lightly behind your ears with elbows wide.
Exhale and curl your head and one shoulder blade up off the floor while rotating your torso to reach that shoulder toward the opposite knee.
Lower your upper back smoothly back down to the floor under control.
Curl and twist toward the opposite side next, alternating sides on each repetition.
tips: Think about bringing your armpit toward your opposite hip rather than pulling your elbow across your face.
Support your head lightly without yanking on your neck.
